log.msg: Extracted. ext/grip = grip.js + grip.css: `grip({ write, done })`, pointer capture on down, `write(px)` every move where px is the width the pointer implies, `done(width)` once on up. Two changes from DevBar's copy: the class on <html> is `grip-sizing` (it carries `--rail-ease: 0s`, the whole reason it touches <html>), and the width is measured from the RAIL'S OWN inline-end edge (`parentElement.getBoundingClientRect().right`, read once at pointerdown) instead of `innerWidth` — which is what lets ext/drawer, offset by `--devbar`, size to the pointer instead of past it. dev/DevBar/grip.js and grip.css are deleted; DevBar.js calls `grip({ write: rail, done: width => set({ width }) })`.

⚠ The brief's three facts are two eras. `--dev-grip: 2rem` + `translateX(calc(100% + var(--dev-grip)))` was the 2026-08-16 MORNING fix; that afternoon (devbar-grip-scrollbar) the grip moved wholly INSIDE the rail at 0.75rem, and both the token and the calc() were deleted as dead weight — a plain `translateX(100%)` clears a grip that is inside the box. Carried the surviving fix, not the superseded one: no `--dev-grip` reintroduced. Measured below.

PROVEN headless (playwright, dev socket blocked), /framework/ext/drawer/ at 1280: open = 304px wide, .app reserves 304. Grabbed the grip, baseline 299 → dragged 160px left → drawer 459px AND .app padding-inline-end 459px — DELTA 160 and 160, the push and the width are one number. <html> carried `grip-sizing` during the drag. Released → localStorage lew42-drawer-w = 459px.
Persistence: closed → reopened at 3440 = 459px (--drawer-w 459px, .app 459); reloaded the page → reopened = 459px. Before this, close() cleared --drawer and every reopen was 19rem.

Nothing lingers. Drawer shut, dev rail shut: grip box 1281–1293 at innerWidth 1280 and 3441–3453 at 3440 — 0px on screen both times; elementFromPoint down the former grip column returns code-block/page/h3 and at innerWidth-2 returns page, at both widths. .app reserves 0. Drawer shut with the DEV RAIL OPEN (the case worth measuring, not assuming): the shut drawer lands at 1008–1312 with its grip at 1009–1021, exactly over the dev rail's own grip — elementFromPoint there returns dev-bar:grip, because .dev-bar is z 50 and .drawer is z 40, and the dev rail still dragged 120px through it with the drawer staying shut. A grip wholly inside the box goes wherever the box goes.

DevBar unchanged in behaviour: dragged 200px → --dev-rail 266px → 466px, bar width delta 200, persisted as {"width":466}. Closed at 1280 and 3440 the grip sits at innerWidth+1 → +13, elementFromPoint returns page at both. Zero console errors on /framework/ext/drawer/, /framework/dev/DevBar/ and /framework/.

assign.outcome:
**The drawer resizes, and the grip is one shared part.** `ext/grip` — `grip({ write, done })`, one small file and its stylesheet — is now the resize edge for BOTH rails. `dev/DevBar/grip.js` and `grip.css` are deleted; DevBar mounts the shared strip with `write: rail`, and `ext/drawer` mounts it inside its own box.

Measured headless at 1280, dev socket blocked: drag 160px → the drawer is **459px wide and `.app` reserves 459px** — the push and the width are one number, in both directions. The width survives close→reopen (at 3440 too) and a full reload, because it is a **new token**: `drawer.close()` clears `--drawer`, so the width lives in `--drawer-w` (one `localStorage` key) and `--drawer` is written as `var(--drawer-w, 19rem)`. `framework.css` needed no change.

**Nothing lingers when it shuts.** Grip box `1281→1293` at innerWidth 1280 and `3441→3453` at 3440 — 0px on screen both times, and `elementFromPoint` down that column returns page content (`code-block`, `page`, `h3`). Shut with the dev rail OPEN, the drawer's grip lands exactly over the dev rail's own — and loses: `.dev-bar` is `z-index: 50`, `.drawer` is 40, and the dev rail still dragged 120px through it with the drawer staying shut. DevBar itself is unchanged: 200px drag → `--dev-rail` 266px → 466px, persisted. Zero console errors on `/framework/ext/drawer/`, `/framework/dev/DevBar/` and `/framework/`; every touched doc url clean at 1600.

Carried the surviving fix; the token stays gone. Record: `ext/grip/doc/decisions.md`.
